_comment_file: The application shell: title bar, tab strip, status bar, footer, inspector, and the two full-area states (empty vault, locked vault). Loaded before the first paint, because it is on screen whenever the window is.

titleBar._comment_: A 38px bar. Every label here is also a tooltip, so short wins — but a disabled control's tooltip says WHY, because 'why not?' is the only question a dead button raises.
titleBar.lockAlreadyLocked: 没有已解锁的保险库可以锁定。
titleBar._comment_lockingShort: Shown in the bar itself, where there is room for one word. The tooltip carries lockInProgress.
titleBar._comment_needsVault: {action} is one of the four labels above. Interpolated rather than concatenated: languages differ on where the subject of this sentence goes.
titleBar._comment_controlFailed: SECURITY-ADJACENT. The window controls are the one place where doing nothing is indistinguishable from being broken. Do not soften this into 'something went wrong'.
titleBar.noWindow: 此页面没有运行在 Remoter 窗口内，因此这里的窗口控件不起作用。

tabStrip.noSessions: 没有打开的会话——双击一个连接即可开始
tabStrip._comment_inspector: Ctrl-free: F4 is a bare function key and is written as-is in every language.

statusBar._comment_protocolUnset: Sits where SSH, RDP, VNC or SFTP would. Lower case: it is the absence of a protocol, not the name of one.
statusBar.showDetail: 在检查器中查看失败详情

footer._comment_: Counts. Every one is a plural: Russian needs four forms here and Arabic six, and the zero case is worth its own wording in the languages that have one.
footer.sessions: {count, plural, =0 {无会话} other {# 个会话}}
footer.tunnels: {count, plural, =0 {无隧道} other {# 条隧道}}
footer.connections: {count, plural, =0 {无连接} other {# 个连接}}
footer.credentials: {count, plural, =0 {无凭据} other {# 个凭据}}
footer._comment_locksIn: {clock} is mm:ss, produced by formatClock() so the digits follow the locale's numbering system.
footer.locksIn: 保险库将在 {clock} 后锁定

inspector.title: 生效值
inspector.nothingSelectedBody: 在树中选择一个连接，即可查看它解析后的设置。
inspector.notAConnection: 文件夹本身没有生效值。
inspector.notAConnectionBody: 文件夹设定的内容会显示在它下面的连接上，作为继承值的来源。
inspector.notAskedBody: 解析需要对着已打开的保险库进行。当前这个是锁定的，因此还没有可解析的对象。
inspector._comment_unset: The value of a field nobody has set, anywhere in the inheritance chain.
inspector._comment_setHere: Provenance labels, shown under a resolved field. 'set here' means this connection's own value; the others name where an inherited value came from. Lower case: they are fragments under a value, not sentences.
inspector._comment_fromSource: {source} is a folder or connection name — user data, in any script, isolated before it arrives.
inspector._comment_overridesInherited: {field} is a field name such as 'port' or 'username'. This is the case worth calling out: the tree above says something different from what will actually be used.
inspector.credentialShared: 在此设置 · 与其他条目共享
inspector.noFields: 此连接没有解析出任何字段。

emptyVault.title: 此保险库是空的
emptyVault._comment_body: {vault} is the vault file's name, which is user data and may be in any script. It is wrapped in a Unicode isolate before it gets here, so the sentence keeps its own direction whatever the name contains.
emptyVault.body: {vault} 里还没有存放任何内容。多数人会先把现有的连接搬过来。
emptyVault._comment_importBody: Product and file names. Not translated.
emptyVault.createBody: 有一个主机、一个协议和一份凭据就可以开始。
emptyVault.openBody: 锁定此保险库并返回保险库选择界面。
emptyVault.openFailed: 此保险库没有被锁定，因此选择界面没有打开。

main._comment_nothingSelectedBody: Ctrl+K is a key name. Translate the sentence around it, not the key.
main.nothingSelectedBody: 在树中选择一个连接，或按 Ctrl+K 搜索。
main._comment_sidebarLabel: The accessible name of the connection tree's landmark region. Read aloud when a screen reader lists the regions of the window.
main._comment_nodeKind: What a selected tree entry is, shown above its name where a connection shows its protocol. These are the node kinds from the domain model; they are shown to the user, so they are translated, unlike the protocol names beside them.
main.connectHint: 在树中双击它、在命令面板中按 Enter，或使用它的右键菜单中的“连接”。
main.folderSelected: 文件夹保存的设置会被它下面的连接继承。
main._comment_lockedBody: SECURITY-CRITICAL wording in one respect: it must keep saying that nothing was lost. A user who believes a lock destroyed their connections will go looking for a backup they do not need.
main.lockedBody: 它在闲置一段时间后自动锁定，或者是在另一个窗口中被锁定的。没有任何内容丢失：连接仍然在文件里，解锁后就会回来。
main.vaultStateFailed: Remoter 无法判断当前是否有保险库处于打开状态。
main.fullscreenFailedBody: 窗口管理器拒绝了这一请求，或者此页面没有运行在 Remoter 窗口内。会话本身没有任何变化。
main.checkingVault: 正在检查是否有保险库处于打开状态…
main.readingTree: 正在从保险库中读取连接…

kdfUpgrade._comment_: SECURITY-CRITICAL SECTION. This is the offer to strengthen a vault's key derivation. Do not soften 'weaker than the current standard' into 'could be improved', and do not drop the sentence explaining why the password is asked for again — a credential prompt without a stated reason is exactly what a phishing dialog looks like.
kdfUpgrade.offer: 此保险库的密钥派生强度低于当前标准。加强它只需片刻，也不需要设置新密码。
kdfUpgrade.dismissLabel: 在下次解锁前不再提示
kdfUpgrade.passwordHelp: 就是您刚才用来解锁的那个密码。每个密钥槽位都会围绕它重建，所以需要再输入一次。
kdfUpgrade._comment_working: Short enough that reserving room for it does not widen the idle button.
kdfUpgrade.workingStage: 正在以更高的开销重新派生密钥…
kdfUpgrade.reading: 正在读取保险库文件头…
kdfUpgrade.readFailed: 无法读取此保险库的文件头，因此无法加强密钥槽位。
kdfUpgrade.keyfileMissing: 此保险库的密码槽位还需要它的密钥文件。
kdfUpgrade.keyfileDialog: 选择此保险库的密钥文件
kdfUpgrade.keyfileDialogFailed: 系统文件浏览器没有打开，因此没有选中任何密钥文件。没有任何内容被发送到保险库。
kdfUpgrade.done: 完成。此保险库的密钥槽位已达到当前开销标准。
kdfUpgrade.blockedKeyfile: 请选择此保险库需要的密钥文件。
